title: Protocol to detect antigen-specific nasal-resident T cells in humans
protocol: Insert flocked swab into the inferior turbinate through the nostril at around 4 cm in.
Twirl the swab 10–20 times inside the nose.
Insert the same swab into the other nostril at around 4 cm in.
Twirl the swab another 10-20 times inside the second nostril.
Place swab into 1 mL of nasal isolation media in a 1.8 mL Eppendorf tube.
Cut excess length of the swab to close the cap of the Eppendorf tube.
Vortex tube vigorously for 10 seconds.
Incubate tube at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Remove the swab from the Eppendorf tube carefully, minimizing trapped media.
Spin down the cells at 1,000 × g for 10 minutes.
Remove supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of culture media.
Repeat steps 3 and 4 to wash the cells again.
Resuspend the cells in culture media to the desired volume.
Aliquot 5% of the total volume of nasal sample to a new Eppendorf tube.
Adjust the volume with PBS so that the total volume in the Eppendorf tube is 50 μL.
Dilute the cells by adding an equal volume (50 μL) of PBS, resulting in a total volume of 100 μL.
Acquire the sample using a flow cytometer.
Set the volume to acquire to 50 μL.
Gate according to Figure 1.
Note down the total number of events acquired in the lymphocyte gate.
Calculate the number of cells isolated: (y × 2 × 2 / 5) × 95 = Number of lymphocytes isolated for further experiment.
Prepare 35% EtOH diluted with sterile water.
Aliquot 25 μL of 35% EtOH into each well.
Tap the plate gently to ensure complete coating of membranes by 35% EtOH.
Allow the 35% EtOH to activate the membrane for 30 s.
Add 200 μL of sterile water into each well to stop the activation.
Wash the plate five times with 200 μL/well of sterile water.
Coat Millipore ELISpot plates with IFN-γ coating antibody in PBS according to stated concentration.
Flick the plate to remove sterile water and tap it dry.
Aliquot 100 μL/well of diluted IFN-γ coating antibody.
Incubate at 4°C in the dark for at least 24 hours.
Remove coating antibody by flicking the plate and tap it dry.
Wash the plate six times with 200 μL/well of PBS.
Aliquot 100 μL/well of blocking media.
Incubate at room temperature (approximately 25°C) for at least 30 minutes.
Dilute peptide pools to a working concentration of 6 μg/mL in culture media.
Dilute nasal cells to a desired concentration of at least 5000 lymphocytes per well.
Remove the blocking media by flicking the plate.
Aliquot 50 μL of peptides into each well (final concentration of 2 μg/mL).
Add 100 μL of nasal cells into each well (total volume: 150 μL).
For negative control, aliquot 50 μL of culture media without peptides into each well.
For positive control, instead of peptides, add 5 μL of α-CD3/28 dynabeads (2 × 10^5 beads/well) with 45 μL of culture media into each well.
Incubate at 37°C in a humidified atmosphere containing 5% CO2 overnight.
Develop ELISpot plate.
Dilute anti-human IFN-γ biotin according to concentrations stated above.
Flick the plate to remove the cells.
Wash the plate 6 times with 200 μL/well of PBS and tap it dry.
Aliquot 100 μL/well of anti-human IFN-γ biotin.
Incubate the plate for 2 h at RT in the dark.
Wash the plate 6 times with 200 μL/well of PBS and tap it dry.
Dilute streptavidin-ALP according to concentrations stated above.
Aliquot 100 μL/well of streptavidin-ALP.
Incubate the plate for 1 h at RT in the dark.
Wash the plate 6 times with 200 μL/well of PBS and tap it dry.
Aliquot 50 μl/well of KPL BCIP/NBT phosphatase substrate.
Incubate the plate for 10–20 min at RT in the dark and wash the plate under running tap water when spots are developed and before the negative control well turns purple.
Check ELISpot plate consistently every two minutes by looking at the negative and positive control wells after 5 min of incubation.
Allow the plate to dry completely until the membrane changes from translucent to opaque white (30–60 min).
Capture the image of each well with Immunospot reader.
Resuspend PBMC at 100 × 10^6 PBMC/mL with depletion buffer in a 5 mL round-bottom polystyrene tube.
Aliquot 100 μL/mL of human CD3 positive selection cocktail to the PBMC and mix well.
Incubate at RT for 5 min.
Vortex RapidSpheres vigorously for 1 min.
Aliquot 60 μL/mL of RapidSpheres to the PBMC and mix well.
Incubate at RT for 5 min.
Top up sample to 2.5 mL with depletion buffer.
Place the tube (without the lid) into Easysep magnet.
Incubate at RT for 5 min.
Pick up the magnet and in one continuous motion pour the supernatant into another 5 mL round-bottom polystyrene tube.
Repeat steps h–j two more times.
Spin down the cells at 400 × g for 5 min.
Remove supernatant.
Resuspend CD3-depleted cells in 1 mL of culture media.
Count the number of CD3-depleted cells isolated using trypan blue staining and counting in a hemocytometer to determine viability and cell count.
Optionally, perform simple flow cytometry staining including Live/Dead, CD3, CD4, and CD8 antibodies to check purity of CD3-depleted cells.
Dilute peptide pool to 20 μg/mL (final concentration of 10 μg/mL per peptide) in 50 μL of culture media.
Resuspend 1 × 10^6 CD3-depleted cells in 50 μL of culture media.
Aliquot 50 μL of diluted peptide pool and 50 μL of resuspended CD3-depleted cells into a 1.8 mL Eppendorf tube.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 1 h.
Spin down the cells at 400 × g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 50 μL of culture media.
Add 2 μL of APC anti-CD107a antibody to the peptide-pulsed CD3-depleted cells.
Add 2 μL of FITC anti-CD40L antibody to the peptide-pulsed CD3-depleted cells.
For negative control, add un-pulsed CD3-depleted PBMC instead of peptide-pulsed autologous CD3-depleted PBMC.
For positive control, add 5 μL of α-CD3/28 Dynabeads with 41 μL of culture media and 2 μL of APC anti-CD107a antibody.
For positive control, add 2 μL of FITC anti-CD40L antibody to the mixture for positive control.
Add 50 μL of nasal cells (containing at least 5,000–10,000 lymphocytes).
Incubate the mixture at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 3 h.
After 3 h, add 500 μL of PBS to the cells.
Spin down the cells at 400 × g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant carefully.
Stain the cells with 100 μL/sample of NIR (1:1000 in PBS) in the dark at room temperature for 10 min.
Add 100 μL of staining buffer to the cells after staining.
Spin down the cells at 400 × g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant carefully.
Dilute BV605 anti-CD3, BV650 anti-CD4, PE-Cy7 anti-CD8, AF700 anti-CD69, and FITC anti-CD103 antibodies in staining buffer to the specified concentrations.
Prepare 50 μL of antibody mix for each sample.
Stain cells with 50 μL/sample of antibody mix for 30 min in the dark on ice.
Wash cells twice with 200 μL of staining buffer each time.
Resuspend cells in 100–200 μL of staining buffer for acquisition.
Acquire samples with a flow cytometer immediately.
